Nicole is an ancestor of Samantha (and thus of Samantha’s descendants), while Joan is an ancestor of Cheryl (and thus of Cheryl’s descendants, including Barbara → Vincent → …). There is no lineage link given that connects Nicole’s line to Joan’s line, so none of the listed relationships (common ancestor/descendant, or one being ancestor/descendant of the other) can be concluded.
